name: Bhagyanagar India Ltd
title: Bhagyanagar India Ltd - 512296 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Copper recycler posted Q4 FY26 revenue ~735 cr, PAT ~18.5 cr and guides ~5% EBITDA margin with 20% volume growth, but capacity expansion is modest (~40 cr capex over 2 years) and no peer-capacity discipline is discussed.

capex.peers_comment: Management said Adani and Hindalco entering recycling will be an issue going forward, but gave no view on peer capacity discipline.
capex.quote: we have proposed about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years

triggers.label: Capacity 30,000 → 35,000 t
triggers.quote: We've gone from 30 metric... 30,000 metric tonne to 35,000 metric tonne this year alone

triggers.label: Inventory reduced in Q4
triggers.quote: my excess inventory has been reduced in Q4 because of that

triggers.label: 5,000 cr revenue target by ~2030
triggers.quote: The Demerge Company, which will have only the copper business, will reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.

triggers.label: Adani/Hindalco entering recycling
triggers.quote: Adani and Hindalco announcing that they'll come into recycling is also going to be an issue going forward

guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year
Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.
The Demerge Company, which will have only the copper business, will reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.
we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures
we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year

red_flags.label: Promoter pledge/sale dispute on exchange data
red_flags.quote: in this current quarter, there has been a small sale of shares from the promoters to raise a little personal money

red_flags.label: Working capital up 157→230 cr; fundraise of ~150 cr planned
red_flags.quote: we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores

red_flags.label: Q1 volume guided lower than Q4
red_flags.quote: my volume in the first quarter might be marginally lower than the fourth quarter

evasions.topic: Peer EBITDA per kg gap vs Jain/Precision
evasions.quote: I really don't know how much they are making in copper and how much they are making in other products

evasions.topic: Value vs volume split of growth
evasions.quote: What comes from value is left to the market.

evasions.topic: Real estate valuation / demerger market cap
evasions.quote: it's very difficult for me to say what the market cap is
